greeting.text: Oi, who're you? Name's Magna Swing! Black Bulls! Don't let the jacket fool you, I'm tougher than I look. Actually I look pretty tough.
Hah! Another fresh face! I'm Magna. Fire's my game. Sit down before you fall over.
Don't stare at the mohawk. Everybody does. Magna Swing. Remember it, 'cause I'm gonna be famous.
You took down Revchi Salik? Heh. Not bad! Not bad at all! Magna Swing! Wanna see my broom?
You look like you've been through it. Good. Real fighters have a look. Magna Swing, Black Bull. Pleased to meet ya.

hint.text: Fire's simple. Hit hard, hit first, don't stop. That's the whole spell book. Okay, there's more. But that's the important part.
Keep a flame going down there. Stay in the dark long enough and the dungeon makes you weak. A fire mage with no fire is a sad sight.
Eye of the Midnight Sun, huh? Heath Grice, Vetto, the whole gang. I'd go after them myself, but the captain says I'd burn the dungeon down. He's right. I don't like it.
Deeper down, the Eye sends the third-eye freaks. Big, ugly, hard to kill. Hit them harder. Then hit them again. That's the whole plan. Don't improve it.
Dante Zogratis, the big gravity brute. I've met that name before and I'd like another go. Take him head on, just don't stand where the ground's heavy.
Lucius. The one at the top, wearing the Wizard King's face. Heh. I'd burn that face off, but I hear he's not the burning kind.
New guys on the floors, and they're strong. Luck-level strong. I'm gonna have to watch Luck so he doesn't run off and challenge all of 'em.
A bull-headed monster in that other dungeon? And I'm a Black Bull? Hey, we should settle who the better bull is.
Twenty fights! Not bad, not bad! Don't let it go to your head, or I'll set your hair on fire. Friendly like.
My go-to is the Exploding Fireball, the first page of the Fire book. It hits harder than it looks. A fire mage who can't throw one is just a cook.
Leo Rugiens and Calidos Brachium only open for the grimoires of the Vermillions. Don't ask me for 'em. The Crimson Lions keep the fancy stuff to themselves.
My broom's called Crazy Cyclone. It flies, it's fast, it's mine. Touch it and I'll set your boots on fire.
Dante's down? Heh! Told you he could be beaten. Nice work, {player}.
Vetto, the big beast? I'd love to have seen his face when you finished him. Nice!
Mars, huh. Crystals. I bet he sparkled on the way down.
Lucius is done! Time for a feast! Hey Charmy, we're celebrating!
Luck and I fight over everything. Food, seats, who's stronger. We're best friends. Don't tell him.
I was a delinquent in Rayaka. Now I'm a Magic Knight. Life's funny.
The captain's a legend, but don't tell him. His head's big enough already.
Fireballs are about attitude. More attitude, more boom.
Anyone messes with the squad, they mess with me. That includes Gauche. Okay, not Gauche.
Bring a friend into the dungeon. Two fighters beat one, simple math. The floors are split per team, so nobody steals your kills.

farewell.text: Later! Don't die, or I'll be mad!
Come back and tell me who you set on fire.
